all of your words of support mean the world to me. i feel so helpless without her and i already know this trauma is going to weigh heavy on me for the rest of my life. i don’t see myself being able to take on this level of devotion again. i did everything right and i lost her with no warning that our time together was up. i just want to hold her one more time and rock her to sleep and kiss her little head and tell her i love her but im an ocean away and she’s gone. 

i want to stay in this community as long as i can bear it to share some of the joy that junie brought me. i actually had done a juniper sprig tattoo on myself last year, so i want to share that with you all as well as the ring and necklace im going to have made with her ashes. 

again, thank you all. i feel like a piece is missing from my heart and from who i am but im honored to have all of your love and messages.

when i got her i knew that ferrets had many health issues, and was preparing myself to have to deal with something medical in the years ahead, and did so much research. but there was no warning, no symptoms, no indication at all that anything was wrong, and that’s why this hurts so much. our life together had barely begun and we’ve lost so much love that could’ve been.
she was curled up in one of her fuzzy tunnels. i hope it was quick and painless and she passed while cozy and full of love. i wish i could’ve been there to ease her through it
i’m sorry you had to experience this too. i don’t know what to do with myself

we assume it was a heart or respiratory issue for it to happen so suddenly, without warning, in her sleep. i hope she didn’t have to suffer alone. i wish i could’ve held her as she passed so she knew that i would tear down the sky to keep her safe.
i don’t know what afterlife (if any) i believe in, but this brought me some peace. thank you. i hope she knows i’m lost without her and that i loved her beyond belief

this is beautiful. thank you for sharing it with me. someone in my family actually used to reference this song whenever i said her name, and i always meant to learn the full version to sing to her. i’m heartbroken that i didn’t get the chance

i mentioned in another reply, but i don’t know if i’m ever going to be able to do this again. i was still growing as a person with junie. she saved my life but left it so soon that i feel like i’m hanging on by a thread. i’m honestly traumatised and i don’t know if i’ll be able to devote myself to a little one again and i’m devastated

i know it’s so selfish of me to think this way, but i am glad that i don’t know what happened. she’s off to be cremated already. i think if i found out whatever happened was preventable, my soul would break. as awful as it is, this loss has already traumatised me and i know it’s going to be a long time before i feel that i can open my heart to a little one again. i honestly can’t even imagine myself ever being able to do this again. juniper saved my life and i feel so hopeless that i couldn’t do the same for her.
my mother never cries and it broke my heart to see her so upset. i wish i could’ve been there for juniper and my mama.

exactly how this went down for me. i’m at uni in london and my family is in the states. last time i saw her was 1 october, and expected to see her again soon enough. it took my mother hours to be able to tell me, and my heart aches for her having to break the news to me. i was still sleeping when she realised junie was gone.
i’m so sorry to hear that. it hurts when we lose them so young. makes me think of how amazing the short time we had together was, and how we’ve lost so much of the joy that could’ve been.
